summary: 21Shares Solana Staking ETF filed an 8-K disclosing two routine operational agreements: a benchmark licensing agreement with FTSE International to replace the expiring CF Benchmarks reference rate for NAV calculation, and an amendment to its sponsor agreement changing sponsor-fee payment timing from weekly to quarterly. These are ordinary course contracts for an ETF, not a special situation such as a merger, restructuring, or activist campaign. No special-situation mechanics apply; the filing is a routine current report.
